info.name: GMP-API
info.description:
GMP Server — GraphQL API (NestJS + Apollo Server + MongoDB)

Base URL: http://localhost:3007
GraphQL Endpoint: POST /graphql
File Upload: POST /upload/image

Auth: Bearer token (JWT)
Headers: Authorization: Bearer {{ACCESS_TOKEN}}

WebSocket:
  ws://localhost:3007          (Messaging)
  ws://localhost:3007/notifications  (Notifications)
  ?token=<ACCESS_TOKEN>
